21:t_2:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「From what we've learned in these two months of fighting, it's almost certain that $$サイデリアル$$ is a military alliance of alien races.」

21:t_2:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If they invaded to get their hands on 《$$地球の次元力$$》...」

21:t_2:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Once they've drained all of the $$次元力$$, they'll simply leave.」

21:t_2:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「Our planet... is going to be fed on by those bastards...」

21:t_2:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$サイデリアル$$ used the other Earth as a forward base to invade this Earth.」

21:t_2:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「The other Earth... the so-called $$翠の地球$$...」

21:t_2:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since it is the same Earth, $$サイデリアル$$ has most likely laid $$レイライン$$ on that Earth as well.」

21:t_2:38.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$... Do they intend to take both Earths and make their $$次元力$$ their own?」

21:t_2:39.en:
$n
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$... How long can the Earth hold out?」

21:t_2:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't know... The Empire may even bring the $$レイライン$$ fully under control, and the Earth may never collapse.」

21:t_2:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「However, since we don't know why they are drawing out $$地球の次元力$$, we cannot predict what happens next.」

21:t_2:42.en:
$n
「Then we just have to hit them as soon as we possibly can.」

21:t_2:43.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... We also have to track down the residents who were put under their rule.」

21:t_2:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, do you have any information on the citizens being gathered from various regions?」

21:t_2:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm afraid we have nothing noteworthy...」

21:t_2:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But if we bring down the $$新地球皇国$$, everything will be resolved.」

21:t_2:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the target is the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

21:t_2:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since the $$レイライン$$ are a system for gathering $$次元力$$, every one of the lines is probably heading for $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

21:t_2:49.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then if we follow the $$レイライン$$, we can reach the enemy's home base.」

21:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「But with our current strength, it would be like going there to die.」

21:t_2:51.en:
$$アルト$$
「Some of our machines were lost or heavily damaged in these two months of fighting, like Captain $$アムロ$$'s $$νガンダム$$ and my $$ＹＦ－２９$$.」

21:t_2:52.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even so, if everyone fighting in other regions got together...」

21:t_2:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But as things stand, everyone has their hands full with the fighting where they are. If $c carelessly assembles, it would tear a big hole in the front line there...」

21:t_2:54.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, if this situation keeps up...!」

21:t_2:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「You don't need to tell me! I already know that...!」

21:t_2:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Everyone is tired. We pushed ourselves far too hard this past week rescuing the people living in that city.」

21:t_2:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's rest first. If we collapse, we won't be able to attack the enemy's home base or bring peace back.」

21:t_2:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Miss $$スズネ$$ is right. Everyone, good work once again.」

21:t_2:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let's go back to Japan for now. We'll rework our countermeasures there.」

21:t_2:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I finally get to go to school for the first time in a while.」

21:t_2:65.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Before long, you'll all be third-years.」

21:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's assuming we take the remedial classes.」

21:t_2:67.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It'll be fine. I'll also submit a report on the Volunteer Club's activities on my end.」

21:t_2:70.en:
$n
(Earth... our world... What's going to happen from here on...?)

21:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $n. How is the $$ジェニオン$$ running?」

21:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n... are you feeling rundown, by any chance?」

21:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It's very rare for you, $n, to say something like that to me.」

21:t_10:9.en:
$n
「...Are you really one to talk? You still can't reach 《$$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$》, right?」

21:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... I thought that if 《$$時の牢獄$$》 were destroyed and the dimensional boundary wavered, I'd be able to contact the parallel worlds...」

21:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If the higher-ups learned that the $$ジェニオン$$ took a $$スフィア$$, I'd probably even get a President's Award...」

21:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... When that happens, I'll treat you, pilot $n, and Miss $$スズネ$$ to a big meal with the prize money!」

21:t_10:13.en:
$n
「That's a relief. You're running as normal.」

21:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is it?! Now you're smirking at me...!」

21:t_10:15.en:
$n
「...I meant it to be a smile...」

21:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it's a good sign. ...It's a bit odd to say this while the Earth is in danger, but...」

21:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ever since you defeated 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, $n, you've been much more human than before.」

21:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that a robot like me should be saying that.」

21:t_10:19.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$ and the others told me. To loosen up a little... that's what they said.」

21:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... So that's the reason behind 'Sullen No More.'」

21:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... you bit on that harder than I expected.」

21:t_10:24.en:
$n
「I'm grateful, $$ＡＧ$$. Now I have a goal.」

21:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you're going for a new image, I'd recommend cutting your hair, though...」

21:t_10:27.en:
$n
(But if I can just manage that, then I...)

21:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's head for the new goal with gusto!」

21:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Another day of giving it my all... business, business!!」

21:t_10:30.en:
$n
「So in the end, it always comes down to that...」

21:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh...! Starting today, I'll sell the new parts I stocked over these two months at the $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

21:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And while I'm at it, the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ will also start operating.」

21:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a new menu in the $$Ｄトレーダー$$. By paying $$Ｚチップ$$, you can get perks that affect the entire unit.」

21:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Put simply, it's like paying an offering and receiving divine blessings.」

21:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying, $n! The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is the crystallization of my dimensional merchant spirit, and a symbol of hope for the future!」

21:t_10:38.en:
$n
「All right, all right. I'll take a good look at it later.」

21:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will keep on celebrating anyone who becomes an ace by shooting down 80 or more enemies, so everyone, do your best!」

22:t_000:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Report! It appears a Resistance operative has infiltrated this city!」

テスタロッサ.evidence: surname of テッサ = テレサ・テスタロッサ (Teletha Testarossa) in glossary; used as 'Colonel Testarossa' (same proposal as dlg_2001_00)

ＹＦ－２９.evidence: short form of ＹＦ－２９デュランダル variants in glossary; Alto's own machine

Ｚチップ.evidence: D-Trader currency paid for unit-wide perks (Z-Crystal); not in glossary

kept_omissions: 21:t_2:66: Sousuke's subject for 補習を受ければ is unstated; Alto, Kouji and Sousuke are all students and Suzune's reply covers the whole club; rendered 'we'
21:t_10:27: the 'that' in 'if I can just manage that' (それさえ出来れば) is unstated in the Japanese; kept vague
uncertain: 21:t_10:20/21: 脱ムッツリ rendered as the coined phrase 'Sullen No More' (keeps the repeat in the next row; the ムッツリ double meaning is lost)
21:t_2:40: 皇国 alone rendered 'the Empire' (taken as 新地球皇国, not tokenized since the bare word is not in the glossary)
21:t_2:66: Sousuke's remedial-class subject rendered 'we' (could be himself only)
22:t_000:1: 'Resistance' kept as plain English (the glossary token レジスタンス means 'Resistance Member', wrong for the organization)
21:t_2:53: $c placed as the subject of 'assembles' (game code, a player-named squad in Jigoku)
21:t_10:39: お祝い for aces rendered 'celebrating'; may be a congratulatory bonus/reward
21:t_10:4-8: $n and AG dialogue assumes 'Miss $$スズネ$$' style kept from Jigoku for 先生
Proposed names: テスタロッサ (Testarossa), ＹＦ－２９ (YF-29), Ｚチップ (Z-Chip); ガドライト written as $$ガドライト#keyword$$ inside 《》
Caption 21:t_10:3 copied from the Jigoku English in the brief
